name: Gatekeeper Rejection
setup: Price approaches a significant positive GEX (yellow) node — the King Node or a major Gatekeeper node between spot and the target. These nodes act as suppressors that dampen volatility and reject price advances.
entry: Fade the approach: limit sell (puts/shorts) as price touches the Gatekeeper or King Node. Enter on green candles into the ceiling. The node absorbs momentum and causes rejection.
exit: Target the next lower node (floor or next Gatekeeper). Take partials at the first Gatekeeper below. Use the '1st/2nd test' rule — high probability of bounce on tests 1-2.
probability: 1st test: ~66% chance of rejection. 2nd test: ~66%. 3rd test: probability SHIFTS to ~66% chance of breaking through.
key_rules: Gatekeeper = node between spot and King (intermediate resistance/support)
King Node = strongest node, the 'final boss' level
3rd Test Rule: avoid fading the 3rd test — probability favors breakout
Node Wash-Off: after a node is tapped and value drops, the level is 'dead'
edge_cases: King Node open: if market opens above King, high probability of fade-back through it
'Sloppy Seconds': don't re-trade a level after it already paid out and node value dropped
